provenance.notes: Markers: square NO3, open circle NO2, filled inverted triangle N2, star N2O, open triangle NH3 (check against the caption). Solid curves in the figure are the paper's model-B fit (Table 1). y axis 0-0.5 mol/L; model B conserves N 1:1 in these units, so N2 and N2O are taken as N-equivalents. Confirm that against the paper text before use. Digitized by Daniel with WebPlotDigitizer (data/digitized_inputs/katsounaros2012_fig1/wpd_datasets.csv); t=0 points pinned to the stated initial concentrations. Checked against the figure image by overlaying the published model B: the residual pattern matches the figure (e.g. NO2 at 30 min sits below the curve, N2 at 180 min below the curve). One visual pass, not pixel-level.
